name: solidity-staking-rewards
title: Checkpoint staking rewards
description: ERC20 staking pool with funded reward schedules, per-user checkpoints and principal-preserving withdrawals.
assumptions: Stake and reward assets must differ. Reward schedules are funded on notification; leftover scheduled rewards roll into the next schedule. Idle emissions and integer dust remain in the contract and cannot be swept by the owner. Owner controls future schedules.
